integrity: The primary open article was inspected at the general IHSB hazard identity, both newly introduced Gaussian-tail special cases, their exact hazard formulas, and the text and figures describing hazard shapes. The large-argument incomplete-gamma asymptotic was cross-checked against the NIST DLMF. The endpoint proof is analytic and the standalone checker was replayed from its packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The theorem excludes globally decreasing hazards but does not classify all interior critical points.
For shape alpha below one it proves existence, not uniqueness, of an interior minimum.
For shape alpha at least one it does not claim global monotonic increase.
title: Neither Gaussian-tail IHSB model can have a globally decreasing hazard
